text.clean: Hello. Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the paperwork this month. We have moved our remittance advice emails to a new mailbox at the same domain. The delivery crew reported that the site gate code worked fine this week. Regards, Bram (North Pier Supply)
text.neutral:
Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from North Pier Supply. Our delivery crew had no trouble with the site gate this week. Remittance advice from us will now arrive from a new mailbox on our usual domain. We really appreciated how quickly the paperwork was handled this month.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Bram
North Pier Supply
--
This message was sent from a shared mailbox.
